title: deaddrop: rate limiter counts only successful posts
description: deaddrop.rs:1036-1045: 4.13 and decode-failure return before check_rate_limit/record_request, so an authenticated context gets unlimited 1536B parse work (OSCORE unwrap + CBOR decode each). Defensible (quota = drops created) but undocumented. Fix: count 4.13 against the bucket or document the chosen semantics in the module doc.
close_reason: Semantics documented in post() doc comment rather than changed: the quota counts drops created; 4.13 and 4.00 return before the rate check and do not consume the bucket. Evidence: the Python reference render_post has the identical gate order (4.01, empty, 4.13, decode, then check_rate_limit), so changing Rust unilaterally would break cross-impl parity. Wire-visible behavior unchanged; deaddrop_vectors 27/27, lib 130/130. Commit <docs(deaddrop) on main>.
